channel.title: Tampa Bay News Monitor
channel.description: Press releases and breaking news, Tampa Bay

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] 20-year-old Haitian immigrant dies by suicide in Ohio; family blames deportation fears
item.description: A 20-year-old Haitian immigrant in Springfield, Ohio, died by suicide Monday. His family says he feared deportation after losing his Temporary Protected Status.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Lindsay Clancy jury reports deadlock for second time; judge orders more deliberations
item.description: The jury in the Lindsay Clancy murder trial once again told the judge that it could not reach a unanimous verdict.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Pizza Hut has a new owner for the first time since 1977 after Yum! Brands sells for $1.5B
item.description: Yum! Brands has sold Pizza Hut for $1.5 billion, ending nearly five decades of ownership dating back to PepsiCo’s 1977 acquisition.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Debt collectors are helping DHS fine immigrants while charging big fees
item.description: Private debt collectors are helping the Trump administration impose massive civil penalties on immigrants accused of being in the country illegally as a way to encourage them to leave on their own.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] 17-year-old on trial for Tampa killing of 14-year-old Jevario Buie
item.description: Jahmir Moore, 17, is on trial this week after being accused of the Tampa killing of 14-year-old Jevario Buie in 2024.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Dyson unveils $499 electric toothbrush with built-in camera and flossing system
item.description: The Dyson Camera Jet analyzes 28 images per second to detect gaps between teeth and automatically delivers bursts of mouth rinse while you brush.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Operation No Escape: 37 fugitives arrested in Tampa law enforcement sweep
item.description: 37 violent fugitives wanted for major crimes were arrested in Tampa during a 90-day joint law enforcement operation, the FBI’s Tampa Division said in a news release Wednesday.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] St. Pete activists push to put city-owned utility on 2028 ballot
item.description: A coalition of St. Petersburg community groups launched a petition Wednesday to create a city-owned electric utility on the 2028 ballot following the expiration of Duke Energy's franchise agreement.
